bib.title: AdaptThink: Reasoning Models Can Learn When to Think

question: Can a reasoning model learn to choose between Thinking and NoThinking mode according to problem difficulty, cutting inference cost without losing accuracy?
hypothesis: NoThinking is as good or better than Thinking on simple problems, so an RL policy that prefers NoThinking subject to a no-accuracy-loss constraint should be more efficient without hurting accuracy.
contributions: Simplify NoThinking (empty thinking, first token </think>) and show it beats Thinking on simpler tasks in accuracy and efficiency
Propose AdaptThink, an RL algorithm with a constrained objective and importance sampling for cold start

method.summary: PPO-style RL (no KL penalty) on R1-Distill-Qwen-1.5B/7B with advantage A = 1(y1=</think>)*delta + R - mean reference reward (K=16 presampled). Importance sampling forces the first token to be </think> or 'Alright' with probability 0.5 each so both modes are sampled from step 0.
method.task: adaptive thinking-mode selection for efficient math reasoning (RL with verifiable 0/1 reward)

training.objective: PPO-style clipped loss, no KL penalty, advantage 1(y1=</think>)*delta + R(x,y) - Rbar_ref(x), samples from importance-sampling distribution pi_IS
training.steps: 314 steps (1 epoch); checkpoints used: step 300 (1.5B), step 150 (7B)

inference.samples: 16 responses per problem for AIME 2024 averaged; other sets not stated; pilot study 16 responses per problem
inference.prompting: NoThinking: force first token </think> (empty thinking). MMLU prompt asks for option in \boxed{}.

metrics.name: RatioIT
metrics.definition: ratio of NoThinking solutions containing thinking keywords such as Wait, Alternatively

eval.protocol: Single trained model per config; baselines re-implemented on DeepScaleR; no seeds or significance tests; checkpoints chosen by test-time accuracy/length balance.

evidence.quote: We train the models for 1 epoch, which is 314 steps in total.

limits: Only 1.5B and 7B models tested due to limited compute
Trained on math only (verifiable rewards); OOD shown only on MMLU
Checkpoints selected (step 300 / 150) for good balance, optimizer and warmup not stated, no seeds
Implicit thinking can arise in NoThinking mode; zero reward for such samples is suggested but not tested
Only the 16K budget is studied; baselines re-implemented by authors
